# Battery Rescue SG

> Car battery replacement in Singapore by Motoserv (CaseTrust-accredited group, 10 outlets). Every battery is a Delkor with a 1-year warranty. 24-hour hotline 8125 9169 (also WhatsApp). Prices include GST and fitting, checked 26 Oct 2026.

## On-site rescue area: Woodlands, Sembawang, Yishun, Ang Mo Kio, Yio Chu Kang, Hougang, Sengkang and Punggol. Elsewhere: walk-in at the 10 Motoserv outlets.

## Other services
- Jump-start: $50 ($80 on public holidays).
- Emergency towing: from $80; king dolly (4-wheel) from $120.
- If our technician comes to you and finds the problem is not battery-related, an onsite service fee of $50 to $80 applies. Final charges depend on location and service requirements.

## Price rules
- Walk-in at any Motoserv outlet (Mon-Sat 9am-6pm): Delkor list price minus $20 with the website code (walk-in only).
- Fitted at your location before 10pm, including Sunday: list price + $50.
- Fitted at your location 10pm-9am and on public holidays: list price + $80.
